probes.title: wide, the brand, the nav, the actions and the tools stand in one row and the menu button is not shown
probes.covers: slots brand, nav (default), actions, tools; settings.collapse none

steps.check: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('#wide'); const shown = (s) => { const n = h.querySelector(s); return Boolean(n && n.getClientRects().length); }; return shown('#wide-link') && shown('#wide-action') && shown('#wide-tool') && !shown('.sf-site-header-menu-button button') && h.querySelector('header .sf-site-header-nav nav[aria-label="Разделы"]') !== null; })()

probes.title: the element draws one banner landmark and keeps the page's named nav

steps.check: document.querySelectorAll('#wide > header').length === 1 && !document.querySelector('#wide').closest('main, article, aside, nav, section') && document.querySelectorAll('#wide nav').length === 1

probes.title: collapsed, the nav and the actions are out of the bar and the menu button names the panel

steps.check: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('#narrow'); const b = h.querySelector('.sf-site-header-menu-button button'); return b && b.getClientRects().length > 0 && b.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && b.getAttribute('aria-haspopup') === 'dialog' && b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Открыть меню' && h.querySelector('#narrow-action').getClientRects().length === 0 && h.querySelector('#narrow-tool').getClientRects().length > 0 && h.getAttribute('data-collapsed') === 'true'; })()

probes.title: the menu button opens the panel: focus on the current page's link, aria-expanded true, sf-site-header-open and -opened
probes.covers: actions.open, events.open, events.opened, layer.traps-focus, host-states data-open

steps.check: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('#narrow'); const p = h.querySelector('.sf-site-header-panel'); return h.querySelector('.sf-site-header-menu-button button').getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' && p.getAttribute('role') === 'dialog' && p.getAttribute('aria-modal') === 'true' && h.getAttribute('data-open') === 'true' && h.querySelector('#narrow-action').getClientRects().length > 0 && document.activeElement === document.querySelector('#narrow-current') && document.documentElement.style.overflow === 'hidden'; })()

probes.title: Escape closes the panel and gives focus back to the menu button
probes.covers: keyboard Escape, events.close reason escape, events.closed, §19.2 focus return

steps.check: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('#narrow'); const b = h.querySelector('.sf-site-header-menu-button button'); return b.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && document.activeElement === b && !h.hasAttribute('data-open') && document.documentElement.style.overflow === ''; })()

probes.title: Tab stays inside the open panel
a press on the scrim closes the panel as outside
a page that cancels sf-site-header-open keeps the panel closed and the action answers refused
the wide bar has no panel to open
the words follow the element's language
the public variables reach what the bar draws
